text_block_list.text: The day of the Yasuda Kinen, which determines the spring mile champion—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's really pouring out there.
This goes way beyond just 'bad track conditions.'

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Even Taiki Shuttle might struggle to win on a track this bad.

The spectators were worried whether Taiki Shuttle
could perform at full strength on a rough track, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, bad weather.
Grey sky, can't see the sun at aall.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: However, no problem! It's all about that "unyielding to rain, immune to colds" spirit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My heart is burning so hot,
it could vaporize the rain into steam!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I'll excite everyone
with my absolute best running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A little rain isn't enough
to stop my power and speed!
